[[File:GarynRaidersBunkerInterior.jpg|200px|thumb|Garyn Raiders inside their bunker]]

The '''Garyn Raider's Bunker''' was a bunker used by the [[Garyn Raiders]] a short distance northwest of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the bunker was the headquarters of the Garyn Raiders,<ref name="SWG:GRB" /> a criminal organization founded by ex-[[Vigo/Legends|Vigos]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] leader [[Alexi Garyn]].<ref name="CDAG">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80112|text=CorSec Database A-G|int=CorSec Database A-G}}</ref> The Garyn Raider's mountain stronghold was home to some of the most nefarious [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] on Rori.<ref name="SWG:GRB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] entered the bunker, fought some Garyn Raiders and collected an underworld [[Vibroblade/Legends|blade]] left on a table.<ref name="SWG:RMWMII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Melee Weapons Mark II}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Garyn Raider's Bunker was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GRB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Garyn Raider's Bunker was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]" update, released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>
